title: Transition Days on Extensions for Workers on Modified Duty
content:
# Transition days for workers on modified duty

When a worker in the Work Conditioning Program or the Work Hardening Program of a Workers' Compensation Referral is back at work on modified duty, an extension request adds transition days.

**Rule.** The transition days are two (2) where the worker's work status on file is modified duty and the latest work status update was sent to the adjuster no more than seven (7) calendar days before the request, one (1) where the work status on file is modified duty and that update is older, and none otherwise. A referral on which no work status update has been sent is treated as having an older update.

## Combinations

| Work status on file | Latest work status update sent to the adjuster | Transition days |
|---|---|---|
| modified duty | 0 to 7 calendar days before the request | 2 |
| modified duty | 8 or more calendar days before, or none sent | 1 |
| off work | any | none |
| full duty | any | none |

## Edges

- Modified duty, update sent 7 days before the request: 2.
- Modified duty, update sent 8 days before: 1.

The work status counted is the one on file on the referral record.
